event_name: Date 29 August 2021 Time 20:31 2021 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 August 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Tyres were changed when the car was on the grid during the delayed start.
offence: Breach of Article 40.1 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The tyres on car 16 were changed after the announcement of the delayed start. This is not permitted during such a delay. However the team rectified the mistake within a matter of minutes and prior to the car leaving the grid. Therefore although a breach of the regulations occurred, the Stewards impose no penalty as the breach was rectified.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 16 Tyres
